# What do you actually owe the IRS this quarter — and when?

> Free calculator for US freelancers, 1099 contractors, and gig workers: computes the IRS safe-harbor quarterly estimated tax payment from your own numbers, gives the four real (weekend/holiday-adjusted) due dates, and exports a downloadable calendar file. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
